title: `nvs agent find` matches a heading's slug and nothing in a section's text.
text: A form a generated chapter under `docs/reference/lang/` names only in prose is found through an example's name or not at all. Every form `every_syntactic_form_is_reachable_through_a_heading` lists is reached today, so the gap is that an example's name is load-bearing for search. It closes when `find` also matches a section's code spans, with a case for a form that no heading names.
